production.note: US model years. First: the R arrived with the 2015 F-Type Coupe ('2015 Jaguar F-Type Coupe Preview'; 'the top coupe is called, appropriately, the F-Type R'). Last: Jaguar says of 2024, 'This marks the final model year of F-TYPE' (jaguar-us-f-type-final-year-2023); for 2024 the 575 hp car was sold only as the 'F-TYPE R 75' special edition (jaguar-us-2024-model-year-highlights: 'F-TYPE P575 R75 AWD').

body.note: The brochure's specification table has F-TYPE R columns for both Coupe and Convertible. The 2015 R was a coupe only; the R Convertible replaced the V8 S Convertible for 2016 (autoguide-f-type-awd-2014: 'The V8 S Roadster is now dead, replaced by a V8 R Roadster'). The Convertible keeps the variant name, so it is not a separate record.

configuration.note: 'JAGUAR 5.0 LITER V8 550 SUPERCHARGED PETROL AWD'; cylinders/valves per cylinder '8/4'

displacementL.note: 5,000 cc ('Capacity cc 5,000'; bore/stroke 92.5/93 mm). Jaguar's launch release also lists 'Engine Capacity (cc) 5000' (jaguar-us-f-type-coupe-unveiled-2013).

drivetrain.note: All-wheel drive was standard on the R from the 2016 model year to the end ('JAGUAR 5.0 LITER V8 550 SUPERCHARGED PETROL AWD'; autoguide-f-type-awd-2014: 'For 2016, all V8 F-Types will come standard with AWD, including the V8 R Coupe'). The launch-year 2015 R Coupe alone was rear-wheel drive (jaguar-us-f-type-coupe-unveiled-2013: 'driving the rear wheels'). See reviewNotes.

transmission.note: 'Eight-speed ZF automatic transmission with QuickShift' (torque-converter automatic). No manual was offered on the V8.

powerHp.note: Quote: "Maximum power HP" ... F-TYPE R: 550 (@ 6,500 rev/min). Same rating at launch: Jaguar's release lists "550@6500 Power (hp@rpm)" for the F-TYPE R Coupe (jaguar-us-f-type-coupe-unveiled-2013). 550 hp applied to model years 2015-2020; for 2021-2024 the R was rated 575 hp (jaguar-us-f-type-brochure-2021: 'Maximum power (hp/rpm)' 575/6,500 for the P575; 2024 as the R 75). 550 hp covers six of the ten model years, so it is the reference rating.

weightLb.note: R Coupe, AWD, 8-speed automatic (the only transmission). Quote: "Weight from lbs" ... F-TYPE R Coupe Automatic: 3,814 | Convertible Automatic: 3,847. AutoGuide reported the same figure when the 2016 AWD car was announced ('the V8 R Coupe now weighing 3,814 lbs', autoguide-f-type-awd-2014). The rear-drive 2015 R Coupe was lighter: Motor Authority reported Jaguar's claim of 3,671 lb (motorauthority-f-type-coupe-2013); Jaguar's 2015MY tech-spec file could not be opened. The 575 hp 2021 R is 3,843 lb coupe / 3,887 lb convertible (jaguar-us-f-type-brochure-2021).

discrepancies.reason: Model year and drivetrain. 3,671 lb is the rear-wheel-drive 2015 R Coupe (Jaguar's claim as reported by Motor Authority); 3,814 lb is the all-wheel-drive 550 hp R Coupe (2016-2020); 3,843 lb is the 575 hp 2021-on R Coupe.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 3,814 lb, the manufacturer figure for the reference configuration (550 hp, AWD).

discrepancies.reason: Model year. 550 hp for 2015-2020, 575 hp for 2021-2024.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 550 hp: it is the launch rating and covers six of the ten model years.

reviewNotes: A human should confirm the reference configuration. The R was 550 hp RWD (coupe only) for 2015, 550 hp AWD for 2016-2020 and 575 hp AWD for 2021-2024. The guide's rule keeps the 550 hp launch rating (six of ten years) and then takes the earliest year with a qualifying weight. The only manufacturer weight that could be opened for a 550 hp car is the US brochure filed as 2017 (AWD, 3,814 lb), so this record describes the 2017 AWD car. Jaguar's own 2015MY tech-spec file exists on its media site but is a zip that could not be opened; if its RWD curb weight is confirmed (Motor Authority reported 3,671 lb), a strict reading of the rule would make 2015 the reference year, with drivetrain RWD and weight 3,671 lb, which describes only one of the ten model years. Also: the brochure does not print its model year (the host files it as 2017), hence confidence medium.
